settings.title: Phone companion
settings.description: See and steer this computer's tasks from a phone browser
settings.enabledDescription: Serve the companion page to paired phones while Workbench runs
settings.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved

listen.label: Reach it through
listen.localhostDescription: Only this computer can open the address; Tailscale passes your own devices through with HTTPS
listen.networkDescription: Plain HTTP: anyone on the same network can read a phone's token in transit, so use it only on a trusted home network. Windows asks once whether to allow Workbench through Windows Defender Firewall; allow it on private networks only. Phones get no notifications in this mode, because browsers offer them only to https pages

tailscale.label: Tailscale
tailscale.description: Install Tailscale on this computer and the phone and sign in to both with the same account. In the Tailscale admin console, under DNS, switch on MagicDNS and HTTPS certificates; without both, Tailscale serves no https address. Then run this once on this computer and open the https address it prints on the phone. Notifications on the phone need this https address; the home network address cannot receive them

devices.title: Paired phones
devices.pairDescription: Open the companion address on the phone and type the code shown here
devices.codeDescription: Type this code on the phone; it works once, until {{time}}

pair.title: Pair with Workbench
pair.instructions: On the computer, open Workbench Settings > Phone, select Show code, and type the code here.
pair.homeScreen: On iPhone, a page added to the home screen keeps storage separate from Safari. Add the page to the home screen first, then pair from the home screen icon; a pairing made in Safari does not carry over.

projects.title: Projects
projects.none: No projects are open in Workbench.

actions.prCreated: Creating the pull request. This screen shows the result when it is done.
actions.merged: Merging the pull request. Conflicts can take some minutes; this screen shows the result when it is done.
actions.revising: Claude Code is applying the feedback.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Workbench notifies this phone when a task is ready for review, fails or is paused by a rate limit, when a pull request is merged, and when an agent needs input or finishes.
notifications.on: Notifications are on for this phone.
notifications.off: Turned off. This phone receives no notifications.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this page. Allow them in the phone's settings, then try again.
notifications.insecure: Notifications need the https address from Tailscale. The home network address uses plain HTTP, where the browser offers no notifications.
notifications.iosHomeScreen: On iPhone, notifications need iOS 16.4 or later and the page added to the home screen: in Safari, select Share, then Add to Home Screen, open the page from the new icon and pair again.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
notifications.failed: Notifications could not be turned on: {{error}}
